[R1] The `glom_cli` command-line interface must accept Python-full specifications rather than being limited to AST literals.
[R2] Expose `Auto`, `Fill`, `Iter`, `Let`, and `ROOT` as public API.
[R3] Expose `Invoke` publicly, rename `consts` to `constants` with backward compatibility.
[R4] `Fill` must have a `__repr__`.
[R5] `Assign` and `assign` must have a `__repr__`.
[R6] `Coalesce` must have a `__repr__`.
[R7] All public specifier types (including `Auto` and `Check`) must have reasonable `__repr__`.

- `glom/reduction.py`: Contains `Fold`, `Sum`, `Flatten`, `Merge`, `flatten`, `merge`.
- `glom/cli.py`: CLI interface using `face`. Currently supports `python` (AST literal), `json`, but not `python-full` (eval).
- `glom/__init__.py`: Exports public API.
